verdict.rationale: cubic automatically reviews every new pull request for logic errors, style issues and security vulnerabilities, so agent-authored PRs are checked without human effort. Flex capacity keeps reviews running past the included reviewed-line limit, and analytics track how much merged code AI tools wrote. Coding agents can also request reviews through the MCP server or CLI. missing for 10: an explicit review mode targeted at agent-authored PRs, independent or hands-on evidence of review quality at high AI-PR volume, documented throughput figures.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the reviewer holds the line on AI-generated PRs — it verifies agent-authored code at a volume no human team could review

citations.quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
The AI automatically scans every pull request for a wide range of issues, including logic errors, style inconsistencies, and potential security vulnerabilities.
Flex capacity keeps GitHub PR AI reviews running after your workspace uses its included reviewed-line capacity.
The AI coding tab (Beta) shows how much of your merged code was written with AI tools, which tools and models wrote it
cubic's MCP server lets your coding agent read review findings, look up codebase documentation, request PR reviews, triage PR or codebase scan issues
